text:
maya: @team ACME (Jess) hit a 403 when switching projects in the console right after an SSO session refresh. They say it used to work and then stopped. Can we triage?
jess_acme: Getting "403 Permission denied" when I click the project dropdown -> select prod. Console shows no actionable button. Happened right after I re-authenticated via our IdP.
maya: Can you paste the exact error payload from network tab or headers (request id)?
jess_acme: Here — took from browser devtools:
```json
{
  "status":403,
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "message": "missing scope: project.read",
  "request_id": "req_8b2f4c9a"
}
```
kevin: That message points to a delegated token that doesn't include project scopes. Do you know if the app requested fewer scopes during the OIDC exchange?
jess_acme: We migrated a SAML->OIDC bridge 2 days ago but IdP team claims they didn't change scope claims. We only see openid/profile/org:read in token introspect.
samir: Two hypotheses: 1) delegated scope shrink during token exchange (client config) 2) role binding disappeared on our side (SCIM / role sync race) — either would yield same symptom.
maya: Can you run a curl simulating the console call and paste auth header & response? e.g.:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/projects/ACME/prod"
```
jess_acme: Ran it. Response 403 and introspect shows scopes: ["openid", "profile", "org:read"]. No project scope. Request id matches req_8b2f4c9a.
kevin: Ok that rules out a purely UI bug. Checking our audit logs for SCIM/resync around that time.
kevin: I see a SCIM incremental resync for acme-okta-client at 2024-12-15T16:50:12Z that failed with a 409 (concurrent update). The reconciliation job retried but left a role_binding tombstone for user jess.acme@acme.com (role removed).
samir: That fits: token still maps org membership but our role binding removed, so token scopes are correct (no project scope). The cause is likely the failed partial apply during the incremental resync.
maya: Proposed path: 1) run targeted full reconciliation for ACME org to restore any missing role_bindings, 2) re-run their delegated token issuance (so new token includes project scopes), 3) ask customer to re-login. For immediate unblock, we can grant temporary project:view to Jess via console.
jess_acme: Temporary grant would help us continue deploys. Appreciate it.
support-bot: Escalation created: #escalations/6021 -> assigned eng-identity oncall.
oncall: I'm picking this up. I'll run a targeted reconciliation against ACME and then a manual replay of the SCIM patch ops for jess.acme@acme.com. ETA ~40m.
oncall: Update 20m — reconciliation started, patch replay in progress, no errors so far.
oncall: Update 35m — reconciliation completed, role_binding restored for project:prod (role:project.viewer). Issued forced token invalidation for the active session so next login will get fresh scopes.
jess_acme: Re-logged in, can confirm project dropdown shows prod and I can view project resources again. No 403. Thanks! :tada:
maya: Closing loop — root cause was a SCIM incremental resync conflict that left a partial apply (role_binding tombstone) for one user. Action items:
- eng-identity to add guard in resync to abort on 409 and retry full-reconcile instead of leaving tombstones (assigned).
- add alert for partial-apply events on SCIM jobs (pager).
- docs: KB for customers about re-login after role-repair.
kevin: I'll open an internal PR with the guard and link this thread.
support-bot: Escalation #6021 marked resolved.
maya: Thanks everyone. Jess — ping me if you see any regression.
jess_acme: Will do. Thanks for the quick help! :heart:
